newsitem.title: USA: Benthos Inc receives two $3 mln orders.
newsitem.headline: Benthos Inc receives two $3 mln orders.

text.p: Benthos Inc said Monday that it recently received two orders each worth about $3 million.
The orders, received the week of October 14, were with its undersea systems division for seismic hydrophones and with its container inspection division for TapTone II systems.
Syntron Inc of Houston ordered the hydrophones, which are underwater microphones used in conducting seismic surveys to determine potential oil and gas deposits beneath the ocean floor.
